term: incorporeal in the first q.75 a.2 subconclusion
definition: IntellectIsNotBody m intellect is exactly the negation of Model.IsBody for the designated principle. It does not negate being a form or part of a human body, identify a complete human person with the soul, or entail the highest immateriality condition that denies componenthood in anything. Non-organic operation, per-se subsistence and immortality are not included.
